text:
harry: Heads-up — canary failed in eu-west right after chart promotion.  CRD validation errors in controller logs, pods OOM/crash.
deploy-bot: [automated] Release catalog/service v7.0.0-canary failed in eu-west. Events: 4/10 readiness failures, CRD apply error: invalid conversion webhook. Release annotations: chart-bumped=true, merged-overlays=[base,region-eu].
ana: Did the chart include a CRD apiVersion change? 7.0.0 had CRD schema migration notes in the PR.
harry: Yep. The chart bump included a new CRD conversion webhook and a schema that requires running a migration job before the controller can start. Logs:
```text
E0101 12:03:01.123 controller.go:200] failed to start: failed to validate CRD: conversion webhook returned 500
```
kevin: Two paths: 1) rollback chart to 6.9.2-stable (quick) — avoids touching CRD but loses new controller fixes. 2) run the migration job in eu-west, keep chart 7.0.0-canary (values-only runbook) and pin the release until migration completes. Change window ~40m.
oncall: Rolling back safer for multi-region, but migration in a single region might be acceptable for canary if we pin and ensure migration job is reversible. We should not apply the new CRD cluster-wide until maintenance window.
harry: Proposal: revert to 6.9.2 in all regions except eu-west where we will run a constrained migration job and keep canary pinned. If eu-west passes for 60m, schedule a maintenance window for coordinated CRD rollout.
ci-bot: Note: PR #7122 documented migration steps and includes a dry-run job. Recommend running the dry-run first.
kevin: Runbook snippets:
```bash
# dry-run migration in eu-west
kubectl apply -f crd-migration/dryrun.yaml -n kube-system --context=eu-west
# promote hotfix-chart with no CRD apply (controller expects migrated state)
helm upgrade --install svc ./charts/catalog -f values.yaml -f canary-metadata.yaml --namespace prod-eu-west --set image.tag=sha-xyz --skip-crds
kubectl rollout status deploy/catalog-controller -n prod-eu-west --timeout=180s
```
ana: Also request deploy-bot pin for eu-west to prevent automated promotions while we validate. I'll raise the pin now.
deploy-bot: Manual pin requested by @ana: pin catalog-service chart to 6.9.2 for global default; allow 7.0.0-canary in eu-west only while migration validates. Automated rollback skipped.
oncall: Good. If dry-run looks clean, run real migration job and monitor for CRD conversion failures. If any error, rollback eu-west controller and restore old CRD.
harry: I'll run dry-run in 10m and update here. After validation, open a short postmortem and schedule the maintenance window for CRD rollout.
ci-bot: Filed issue #7233 to add a preflight to deploy-bot: block chart bumps that include CRD apiVersion changes unless a migration plan is attached to the PR.
kevin: After this, add a runbook note: "When bumping chart with CRD conversion schema changes, include dry-run migration job and schedule maintenance window."
harry: Dry-run started — will report back in ~12m.
deploy-bot: Pin applied for catalog-service as requested. (automated)
